OVERVIEW

Build with Claude.

One family. A range of creative possibilities.

A model family for thoughtful writing, complex reasoning and code-focused workflows. Start with a representative task, compare outputs against your quality requirements, and choose the exact model version that fits your application. The family overview helps you plan; the selected version defines supported inputs, limits and billing.
